name: vulnscan
label: Vulnerability scan
description: A scope-gated security check of devices you own: nmap service discovery plus safe NSE vulnerability scripts, TLS certificate and protocol checks, and web hardening checks (headers, exposed files, directory listing, HTTPS redirect, cookie flags). The page at /vulnscan is the GUI (targets, profiles, history, scope editor). With the scope guard off it runs against any host or network (unrestricted); with it on, the target must be in the allowlist.
